description: Hidden Disabilities Sunflower Card - Some disabilities are hidden

secondaryFields.label: Purpose
secondaryFields.value: Indicates I may need extra help or understanding

backFields.label: What is this?
backFields.value: The Hidden Disabilities Sunflower is a discreet symbol worn by people with hidden disabilities. It helps people in public spaces who may need extra help or understanding.

backFields.label: Message
backFields.value: Some disabilities are hidden. Please offer me help if I need it.

backFields.label: Official Colors
backFields.value: Dark Green (#006341), Sunflower Yellow (#FFC72C), Leaf Green (#00A651)
